purpose: Authoritative source registry for Pieceful content ingestion. Rights are evaluated per provider and, where required, per item.

met.rights_gate: Require API isPublicDomain=true and a non-empty primary image before accepting an item.
met.notes: The Met marks Open Access public-domain artwork images as CC0. Pieceful still preserves creator, source URL and credit-line metadata.

npm.rights_gate: Verify the downloadable image tier and its item-level licence before accepting it; do not infer rights from visual content.
npm.notes: Low-resolution open images are published under CC0; medium-resolution images are published under CC BY 4.0 and require the museum credit format.

rijksmuseum.rights_gate: Accept only records whose published copyright/licence notice is one of the approved open-rights values.
rijksmuseum.notes: The collection contains open and restricted material, so Pieceful must preserve and evaluate the record-level rights statement.
